title: chrysanthemum suaveolens
intro: Chrysanthemum suaveolens, commonly known as Sweet Chrysanthemum or White Chrysanthemum, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to reduce fever, alleviate headache, and promote relaxation. The health benefits of Chrysanthemum suaveolens include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues and relieve stress. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum suaveolens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedation, analgesia, and antipyretic effects.
